reviews.title: Does not identify trips well; has actually gotten worse
reviews.text: Not sure what has happened, but TripIt does not automatically identify trip details. Have a super long list on unfiled. One would think that with the AI tools that TripIt would have gotten better, but it’s actually worse. Additionally, it misses most reservations that hit my Gmail. I love the tool but defeats the purpose when you need to manually enter everything.

reviews.title: No calendar sync options
reviews.text: There no calendar sync option to configure display only top title of the trip and not intermediate days in the calendar

reviews.title: Very poor app
reviews.text: If you want to organize all the details of your trip in one place, do it somewhere else. This app was no help at all. I diligently put all my information into the app. While I was in Paris it initiated a false security alert and froze my account. I had to interact with support staff directly; they were 9 hours different in time zone so middle of the night for me and early morning for them. It took days to resolve. Meanwhile all the details I had entrusted to them were unavailable to me. It was very disruptive.  And now I’m questioning whether they sold all my info. I recommend taking a pass on this one.

reviews.title: Don’t do it

reviews.title: Does Not Work Properly
reviews.text: This app needs a lot of work on the interface as well as customer support. After I paid the subscription fee to take advantage of all the features it promises the app would not pull in data from any of my rewards programs. I tried to contact support for help but I had zero luck there because no one responded to my requests for help. I ended up getting my money back from Apple. The app really needs to have a fully integrated packing list reminder incorporated into it as well. With today’s technology a person should not need two or three apps in order to plan a vacation.

reviews.title: Great service poor app
reviews.text: I’ve been a Pro subscriber for well over a decade but this app has not kept up. You can’t share info to it except via email, and that often fails. It can’t even parse reservations email from Marriott, one of the largest hotel chains in the world! I have contacted tech support and they say to enter info manually. Gee, thanks.

reviews.title: 20 years of loyalty, repaid with a 404
reviews.text: 20 years a user, most of them Pro. On 8/29/26 TripIt killed all third-party sync — Flighty, Tripsy, everything — after promising existing connections would keep working. What's left is an unreliable manual calendar feed. My travel history is now hostage to a GDPR request. The parser still works fine; it worked fine in 2009 too. Everything since has served SAP's expense management revenue funnel, not the traveler. TripIt gone. Yet another worthless travel organizer. Maybe it’s time to build my own.

reviews.title: Why do I have to log in every single time
reviews.text: LOVE this app, but the login experience is terrible. I hate the fact I have to log in every time I use it, and it’s worse if your account is connected to Google, you can’t even toggle the remember me. Incredibly frustrating.

reviews.title: Password checker is broken
reviews.text: Can’t create new account. Any complex password beyond 15+ characters is rejected.  Also, the app doesn’t clue you in on what constitutes a “strong password “ even if your chosen password is 15+ characters. Such a fundamental failure in the UI. Good luck new users.

reviews.title: One step closer to grave
reviews.text: This app and service have stopped improving since the acquisition of the company. Unfortunately once acquired by Concur, services go to die. Over the past couple of years the developers have made zero effort to improve the issues and bugs associated with this service. The app is notoriously bad at distinguishing trips so if you have two trips close to each other, it's very likely that it will think it's a whole thing, no matter if they're in two parts of the world. With all the advancements in AI today it's mind-boggling how the company hasn't made any effort to fix this known issue.

reviews.title: No longer reliable
reviews.text: So sad to day goodbye to Tripit but it’s entirely unreliable. You’ll spend more time fixing the apps itinerary errors than booking & planning your trip!

reviews.title: I used to love this app
reviews.text:
I’ve used TripIt for a long time and really like the app. It has been my go-to travel organizer because I can forward confirmations from airlines, hotels, tours, activities, etc., and have everything organized in one simple chronological itinerary. Unfortunately, since changing to a new iPhone, the app has become almost unusable.

Initially, I could not log in at all. I uninstalled and reinstalled the app, tried with my VPN on and completely off, changed VPN protocols, and eventually the next morning I was suddenly able to log in again. All my existing trips were there, but now I cannot save any changes. Every time I edit an itinerary, I get: “Unable to save changes at this time. Please try again later.”

I also tried logging into TripIt through Safari and Chrome with the VPN completely disabled, and I cannot log in there either. So this does not appear to be simply a VPN or app installation issue.

I really don’t want to switch to another travel app. TripIt does exactly what I need and I already have several upcoming trips organized here. I’m posting this review hoping the developers see it and can help identify what is happening with my account. Please help me resolve this issue.

Very frustrating. I had the pro version for a short period of time, but I refused to pay for a subscription to an application that is always broken

reviews.title: It’s time to move on
reviews.text: Unless this platform updates its intelligence it’s over for me.  I’ve use this platform for over five years and previously loved it. It was simple mining my email for upcoming travel plans or I could simply forward the travel plan and nobody inserted into a trip. Now it inconsistently reads my email and when I do forward it to plans at Tripit can’t even read it and always files. It tells me there was a problem with my sub submission. Even when it’s obviously part of the trip in the same city during the same date, the AI assistant it uses will ask me what trip I should add this to once I go in and try to manually add it. I’ve been on the pro version for years and I pay a lot of money for this and used to love it, but with the fast moving intelligence of other apps, this is now become an annoying burden. I might as well just add my own plans to a dumb app. That’s essentially what I’m doing. Hopefully they’re planning an urgent update on there intelligence features but if they’re not, I can’t believe I’ve been paying for this.

Pretty much like the rest of this app - hopeless and a waste of time.

reviews.title: Whatever
reviews.text:
I’ve been trying to use TripIt to organize my upcoming trip, and the experience has been really frustrating. I spent a long time manually entering detailed information, only to eventually be prompted to upload screenshots of my bookings. After going through that extra work, I was suddenly blocked by a paywall because free accounts only allow three attachments.

I don’t mind paying for an app if I know upfront what the limitations are, but TripIt doesn’t warn you until after you’ve done all the work. It feels like wasted time and really poor communication around feature limits.

I actually came to TripIt because it was recommended to me, and I expected it to make things simpler. Instead, I’ve ended up reverting back to keeping my details in email and on my phone, because at least that doesn’t surprise me with restrictions after the fact.

TripIt may still be useful for some people, but clearer up-front transparency about limitations would make a big difference.
